Title: Aarav's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aarav - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Aditi - 12 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Neeta - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditi stands in the living room. Aarav and Neeta stand near her.]

Neeta: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditi puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Neeta: "What happened?"

[Aarav's phone rings and he answers it.]

Neeta: "That was fun!"

[Aarav opens the door and goes out.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Aditi stand near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Aarav searches for his lost ball.]

Aarav: "That's easy."

[Aarav sings a song.]

Aditi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Aarav (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Neeta (excited): "Well done!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Neeta: "What a day to remember!"
